The '''Silver Trophy Fishing Sack''' is a {{Rare}} [[Sack]] that holds {{Green|512}} of each {{Gray|Silver}} [[Trophy Fish]]. 

== Obtaining ==
The '''Silver Trophy Fishing Sack''' can be obtained as a reward for reaching [[Odger#Adept Trophy Fisher|Adept Trophy Fisher]], and can be bought from [[Odger]] for {{C|5m}} after reaching the milestone.

== Usage ==
The '''Silver Trophy Fishing Sack''' can store {{Gray|Silver}} [[Trophy Fish]].
